layout: raw/<SYMBOL>.csv (canonical raw-client output, bytes as received serialized once)
meta/<SYMBOL>.request.json (request params, config, runtime pins, acquisition UTC timestamp, source=yahoo/yfinance)
manifest.json (this manifest + per-file sha256 + acquisition ledger)
archive.publication: write temp in same dir -> fsync file -> os.link(tmp, final) (atomic, FileExistsError if final exists: genuine no-clobber, no check-then-act window) -> unlink temp -> fsync dir; per-file SHA256 computed on final bytes. Proven by two-process collision fixture C8 in run_preflight_fixture_r2.py. NOTE: os.rename is NOT O_EXCL and is not used for publication (r1 claim corrected in r2).
archive.restart: final files are hash-verified and skipped (never re-requested, never overwritten); collision on an existing final path = WRITE_ONCE_COLLISION, stop
archive.rollback: archive is additive and write-once; nothing in live state is touched, so rollback = abandon the capture dir (retained as evidence, marked INCOMPLETE); no deletion of prior captures ever

estimated.rows_total: ~282,000 (45 XNYS symbols x ~505 sessions x 7 bars ≈ 159k; 7 crypto x 17,520 h ≈ 123k)
estimated.wall: ~3–6 min at limiter spacing + observed latency

fail_closed_on: partial response (rows stop mid-session without end-of-window coverage)
call_budget.limiter: one shared limiter, >=1.0 s between request starts, process-wide
call_budget.retry: none — no blind retry, no fallback source, no pagination

capture_id: YAHOO-1H-CLEAN-CAPTURE (execution instance id assigned at separate authorization)

abort_rules: any fail-closed trigger -> stop immediately, keep partial archive as evidence, mark capture INCOMPLETE_HOLD
no resume of an aborted capture except per attempt-journal rules
qualification runs only on a complete 52/52-accounted archive; baseline preflight only after qualification PASS + bytes/hashes pinned
execution_packet.note: execute_capture.py is written at the separately authorized execution task from this frozen packet, reusing the fixture-proven archive/construction/gate code paths in this package; it does not exist yet and this preflight creates no acquisition machinery against the live vendor

purpose: Reacquire Yahoo 1H bytes for the frozen C1 contract (UNIVERSE_X 51) after loss of backtest_cache/v3; LIMITED data tier, not PIT-clean
qualification_gates_frozen: G1 completeness: 52/52 symbols accounted — qualified, COVERAGE-LIMITED, or HOLD with named cause; zero silent exclusions

G2 coverage: sessions present / XNYS sessions in window per symbol; <80% of window sessions = COVERAGE-LIMITED (counted, retained, flagged — not dropped); listing-age exceptions only where first-trade date is evidenced in actions/meta
G3 integrity: duplicate timestamps = 0, nonmonotonic rows = 0 (any occurrence = HOLD)
G4 sessions: missing expected sessions/bars enumerated per symbol vs XNYS calendar; unexplained gaps = HOLD
G5 OHLCV sanity: High>=max(Open,Close), Low<=min(Open,Close), Volume>=0; any violation = HOLD
G6 timezone/DST: bar labels on DST transition weeks exactly 09:30/13:30 ET with correct UTC offsets; any UTC-anchored label = HOLD (the D1 defect class)
G7 early close: known early-close dates emit exactly one 09:30 bar aggregating the 4 morning 1H rows
G8 actions: split/dividend rows reconciled against the frozen split-exclusion protocol; unhandled split inside window = HOLD for that symbol
G9 conservation: raw->4H per-bar aggregation recomputed independently; volume sums and first/last OHLC match exactly
G10 two-window parity: bars built from a short window and from the full window are byte-identical on the overlap, across a DST boundary
G11 hash stability: re-hash of the archive equals manifest SHA256SUMS exactly; any drift = HOLD

request_order.note: benchmark dependency via pine_signal_quality.load_benchmarks (SPY/QQQ); SPY already in universe at i=39; QQQ is the only added request

request_params.client_call: yfinance.download(single symbol) — one symbol per request, threads=False, group_by not applicable

date_policy.consequence: Coverage vs the 2023-01-01 prereg target will mark symbols COVERAGE-LIMITED under the <80% rule; fold calendars must be re-frozen from actual pulled coverage at the later qualification step, before any performance is computed.
date_policy.earliest_date_limit: If executed 2026-10-16, earliest obtainable 1H ≈ 2024-10-17. The prereg target start 2023-01-01 is NOT reachable at 1h. The lost 2023–early-2024 bytes are unrecoverable and are not implied recovered by this capture.
date_policy.reachback_basis: Yahoo 1h hard limit ~730 days, consistent with the evidenced reachback

runtime_pins.drift_rule: executor must re-hash client files + versions at start; any mismatch vs these pins = RUNTIME_DRIFT HOLD before any request

rules: retain raw 1H bytes untouched; construction is a derived, reproducible view
timestamps -> America/New_York; restrict to regular session [09:30, session_close)
4H bars: morning [09:30,13:30) labeled 09:30, afternoon [13:30, session_close) labeled 13:30; left-labeled, left-closed; OHLCV = first/max/min/last/sum
session_close from XNYS calendar (16:00 regular, 13:00 early close); early-close days emit only the morning bar; unknown dates fall back to 16:00 and are flagged
crypto (-USD) is segregated: UTC bins 00/04/08/12/16/20, never session-filtered, never mixed into the equity baseline set
no forward-fill; empty bins dropped; forming bar excluded by causal cutoff at acquisition time

symbol_mapping: canonical Yahoo symbol == frozen symbol for all 52 (no BRK-B/class-share or FX translations in this set); any response whose returned symbol/meta does not match the requested symbol exactly = SCHEMA_DRIFT HOLD
